title: Winterfall Village
wikitext:
[[Image:Winterfall Village.jpg|thumb|Winterfall Village]]

'''Winterfall Village''' is a large [[village]] of [[corrupted furbolg]]s in the far eastern area of [[Winterspring]] {{co|65|34|Winterspring}} near [[Everlook]]. The corrupted furbolgs of Winterfall Village are some of the highest level [[furbolg]]s in the game, so approach the village with caution. The village is ruled by [[High Chief Winterfall]], who resides in a small cave at the very top of the settlement, though he does wander out of his holding from time to time with a guard escort at his side.
